_readme: Optional. Only list photographs that need something better than the default.
Keys are the photo id: the filename without its extension (DSC01757.JPG -> DSC01757).
caption  short editorial line under the frame (default: the capture time)
alt      what is actually in the frame, for screen readers. Please write these.
note     a second line, shown only in the photograph viewer
weight   lead (a full plate) | major (opens a row) | minor (default)
order    a seat number counting from 1; unpinned frames flow around it by capture time
takenAt  2026-08-29T14:20, for a frame whose file lost its EXIF (camera wall clock)
featured true opens the journal with this photograph (the first one wins)
hidden   true keeps the file in the repo but off the page
A caption written against an old filename follows the photograph when a
higher-resolution version replaces it. See /admin/photos for what needs work.

DSC01757.caption: Arrival
DSC01757.alt: A covered hotel entrance passage with dark timber beams and tall potted palms, a brass luggage cart at the left and daylight falling across the tiled floor.

DSC01758.caption: An indoor garden
DSC01758.alt: A tall palm in a grey planter above a bed of low leafy planting, on a pale stone floor, with a lit display window behind and daylight coming from an opening above.

DSC01775.caption: Breakfast, first
DSC01775.alt: People serving themselves at a breakfast buffet — pastries and fruit on wooden boards, serving tongs, a tall dark urn behind, a backpack set down on the floor.

IMG_7879.caption: Before the room fills
IMG_7879.alt: A ballroom set with round banquet tables and cream chairs, one projection screen lit against a dark stage curtain, a few people already seated at the far side.
IMG_7879.note: Twenty tables, set for twenty conversations.

DSC01762.caption: Geometry overhead
DSC01762.alt: A hexagonal light fitting of lit tubes, its mirrored interior repeating the shape inward, set against a ceiling of dark vertical slats.

IMG_7878.caption: The floor plan
IMG_7878.alt: A printed floor plan pinned to a wall, showing twenty numbered round tables in front of a stage, with the AV positions marked.

IMG_7877.caption: The table themes board
IMG_7877.alt: A printed board headed “Table Themes”, listing twenty numbered tables against a faculty name and a discussion topic.
IMG_7877.note: The full list is transcribed further down this page.

DSC01781.caption: “Come for the learning. Stay for the people.”
DSC01781.alt: A presenter in white stands on a low stage beside a large screen reading “Welcome to LEADderm — Come for the learning. Stay for the people.”, under a coffered ceiling, a chandelier at the top left.
DSC01781.note: The welcome slide, in the meeting’s own words.

IMG_7885.caption: Opening remarks
IMG_7885.alt: A person stands on a low stage beside a projection screen reading “Welcome to LEADderm”, seen over the heads of seated attendees.

IMG_7886.caption: The floor
IMG_7886.alt: A bearded man in a mustard jacket and a patterned bow tie, holding notes, in front of a dark red stage curtain.

IMG_7884.caption: Mid-session
IMG_7884.alt: A wide view across banquet tables toward the lit screen, a coffee cup and a pen on the table in the foreground and a table card at the right.

DSC01774.caption: Between sessions
DSC01774.alt: Half a dozen people standing and talking around a cloth-draped high table in a hotel foyer, a chandelier overhead and a second table in the foreground.

DSC01778.caption: “One thing that keeps me grounded…”
DSC01778.alt: A board on an easel printed with a thought bubble reading “One thing that keeps me grounded is…”, five sticky notes added around it, and someone walking past behind.
DSC01778.note: The 2026 meeting is themed Strong Ground.

DSC01783.caption: “Leadership isn’t always quiet.”
DSC01783.alt: A printed card standing on a table: “Leadership isn’t always quiet. Sometimes the best ideas make a little noise. Keep challenging assumptions. Keep asking questions. Keep sparking conversations. Keep making an impact. Enjoy the Pop Rocks… and make some noise!” A second card behind it reads Entrepreneurship.

DSC01784.alt: A man in a dark suit and glasses stands alone at the centre of a low stage, a lavalier microphone on his shirt, between two warm uplights on the dark curtain, seen over the heads of the audience.

DSC01790.alt: An arm’s-length selfie of four men in front of a projection screen showing a QR code and “Download the LEADderm mobile app”, all smiling, the frame soft with motion.

DSC01793.caption: “Download the LEADderm mobile app.”
DSC01793.alt: Four men stand in a row with arms around each other’s shoulders in front of a projection screen showing a large QR code and “Download the LEADderm mobile app — www.leadderm.org/mobile”, the two at the ends giving a thumbs-up and a shaka.
DSC01793.note: Take two, twenty-five seconds after the selfie.

DSC01801.alt: Three men pose side by side in a bright, daylit lounge, arms around each other’s backs, two framed botanical prints on the wall behind them and a patterned carpet underfoot.

DSC01824.caption: Under the string lights
DSC01824.alt: Two men pose arm in arm at an outdoor evening gathering, one pointing a thumb at the other, string lights and an umbrella against a deep blue dusk sky, a wine glass on the cloth-draped table behind.

DSC01827.alt: A night-time arm’s-length photograph of three people seated close together on white folding chairs, strings of warm bulbs crossing the darkening sky above them, palms silhouetted behind.

DSC01838.alt: Two people pose side by side in front of a dark curtain washed with purple light, both wearing lanyards, one giving a thumbs-up.

DSC01841.alt: A woman in a periwinkle-blue coat over a black dress laughs with her hands clasped, standing on a carpeted stage in front of a black drape with a band of violet light.

DSC01846.alt: An arm’s-length group photograph of four people shoulder to shoulder in front of a dark drape, all smiling, name badges on their lanyards.

DSC01849.alt: Photographed from low in the audience, a woman in a white blazer dress stands mid-sentence on stage with both arms spread wide, a black drape lit purple behind her.

DSC01853.alt: A woman in a white blazer dress and a taller man in an olive polo shirt stand together on the stage riser, arms around each other’s backs, purple uplights spaced along the drape behind.

DSC01855.alt: Four people stand arm in arm on the stage riser in front of the dark drape, one giving a thumbs-up, two bags set down on the platform edge beside them.

DSC01862.caption: “Heart-led entrepreneurship”
DSC01862.alt: A woman smiles at the camera holding a printed table card reading “Dr. Manju Dawkins — Heart-led Entrepreneurship”, the projection screen glowing behind her.
DSC01862.note: One of the twenty table themes, held up for the record.

DSC01868.caption: Back in the lobby
DSC01868.alt: Two people smile at the camera in the hotel lobby — one crouched with a thumbs-up, one seated on a velvet sofa with a straw tote bag beside her — the plant-filled shelves and lamps of the lounge glowing behind them.

IMG_7900.alt: A person in black stands mid-gesture on the stage in front of the dark curtain, both hands raised, a warm streak of light on the drape at the left.

IMG_7925.alt: A bald man with glasses, in a navy blazer and patterned tie, gestures with a raised open hand on stage, the tops of banquet chairs soft in the foreground.

IMG_7943.alt: A woman in a blue-and-white floral dress stands mid-sentence on the stage riser, both hands raised, a coppery band of light in the curtain behind her.

IMG_7948.alt: A man in a blue suit and dark red tie speaks with an open palm turned upward, a clicker in the other hand, seen past the back of a head in the audience.

IMG_8002.alt: A woman with long blonde hair stands with hands clasped, smiling toward the side of the room, a lavalier microphone at her neckline and purple light in the curtain folds.

CC13772F-BFE0-4388-86CD-08DE8C40C09C.alt: A night-time selfie of two men giving thumbs-up under strings of warm bulbs, hedges and empty chairs in the darkness behind them.
